**Denied or failed**

**No local records yet** (not yet imported, not granted, denied, or genuinely empty)

- **Google:** blood glucose, body, cardio fitness, ECG, exercise, heart, IRN, nutrition, reproductive health, sleep, SpO2/breathing/temperature, symptoms and mood

**Connection status**
- Neither provider is connected. No tokens are stored, so no API data has been verified.
- Google has no ghealth CLI credentials. While its consent screen is in Testing mode, refresh tokens expire after 7 days.
- Fitbit isn't configured. Its legacy Web API is scheduled to shut down on 2026-10-30, so it may not be a usable path.

If you want more data, the next step is connecting Google (I can try reusing ghealth CLI credentials or open a browser sign-in) and then importing history. Alternatively, you can import a Google Takeout or Fitbit export file.
